capabilities: Show every release with date, sales channel and price
Search by name, dex number, type or trainer role
Mark figures as owned or wishlist
disambiguation: Not a note-scaling or image-resizing tool; it is a catalogue of 1/20-scale Pokémon figures.
extras: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Bandai, Nintendo, Game Freak or The Pokémon Company. Figure data ships inside the plugin; only images are fetched online, and the optional offline image cache takes about 50 MB in the plugin folder. A separate web app offers the same dex with collection stored in browser local storage.
problem: The official Scale World dex is Japanese-only, runs behind new announcements, and does not record what a figure cost or when it was re-released.

relations.evidence: English names, types, evolution lines, Legendary / Mythical: PokeAPI.

summary: Catalogue of Bandai Pokémon Scale World 1/20 figures with release dates, prices, and an owned/wishlist collection.
